title: ADM Announces More Than $60 Million in Investments at Decatur Oilseed Facility - Yahoo Finance
The S&P 500 Has a “Pure Value” Version. RPV Gives Its Cheapest Stocks the Biggest Weights
summary: Most S&P 500 funds hand the biggest weights to the market's winners. One lesser-known fund flips that logic, loading up on unloved health insurers, automakers, and refiners. Does it deserve a spot in a retiree's portfolio, or is the discount a trap?
